name: DhirDhar Solution v2.1.3
changelog:
DhirDhar Solution v2.1.3 Release Notes:

### Dashboard & Analytics
- Outstanding Overview calculated strictly year-wise for the selected year.
- Opening, New Loans, Payments, and Closing balances isolated year-wise.
- 12-month January-December grouped vertical bar chart with dynamic scale up to ₹10,00,000 (10 Lakh).
- Distinct bar colors: New Loans = Orange, Withdrawals = Red, Deposits = Green, Interest Earned = Blue.
- Total Borrowers card status indication: Active count in Green, Closed count in Red.

### Business Profile & Borrower Management
- Business-profile-based prefix generation with immutable alphanumeric borrower numbering.
- Interest calculation for active borrowers using authoritative financial engine.

### Multilingual & Input System
- Full UI localization across 12 Indian languages.
- Dedicated phonetic typing IME with strict language boundary isolation.
- Centralized "Notes" / "Self" (પોતે / स्वयं / Self) multi-word field localization.

### Backup & Restore
- Human-readable binary backup file size formatting (B, KB, MB, GB, TB) with Indic digit localization.
- Google Drive backup metadata integration.

### Printing & POS Paper Settings
- Real-time Windows printer discovery via native Windows printing subsystem.
- Dynamic querying of printer-supported paper sizes (A4, A5, Letter, 58mm, 80mm roll).
- Thermal auto-cut support with ESC/POS hardware command dispatch.
- Multilingual Test Receipt printing with instant status feedback.

### Security & Installer
- Hardware-backed authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM).
- Windows x64 production installer: DhirDhar-2.1.3-x64-Setup.exe (Version 2.1.3).
